items.title: 美國、中國AI投資收益有限！台灣、南韓、日本成最大贏家？
items.title_en: Limited Returns from US and China AI Investments! Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan as the Biggest Winners?
paras: 中美兩國近年競相投入天文數字的人工智慧（AI）建設資金，這股熱潮如今已具體反映在各地的經濟數據上，但受惠程度卻呈現明顯落差。美國雖是投資規模最大的國家, 實際拉抬經濟成長的效果卻相對有限；反倒是南韓、台灣、日本等半導體出口重鎮，短期內享受到遠超預期的成長紅利。
根據史丹佛大學「以人為本人工智慧研究院」（HAI）統計，2013 年至 2025 年間，美國民間累計投資 AI 相關領域達 7572 億美元，穩居全球之冠，其中光是 2025 年一年就砸下 2858 億美元，占比逼近四成。
中國則以 1318 億美元緊追在後，規模不到美國的兩成，不過若計入官方基金投入，實際金額恐怕不止於此。
儘管資金瘋狂湧入，美國經濟成長受惠的幅度卻不如表面數字亮眼。摩根士丹利估算，數據中心等 AI 相關支出原本可將美國 GDP 成長率推升 1.37 個百分點，但由於美國建設數據中心所需的先進晶片與通訊設備高度仰賴進口，一旦扣除進口增加對成長率造成的負面拖累，AI 投資對美國經濟的實質貢獻，恐怕僅剩 0.16 個百分點。
值得留意的是，隨著數據中心建設案接連上馬，尖端晶片與伺服器供不應求，價格節節攀升，連帶讓搭載相關晶片的產品與服務也承受漲價壓力。
美國聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）曾多次強調，AI 普及長期而言有助於提升生產力並壓低物價，但就眼前情勢來看，需求擴張帶來的漲價效應顯然更為明顯。
聯準會理事沃勒（Christopher Waller）甚至警告，若 AI 投資持續狂飆，恐怕反倒會成為推升通膨的新變數。
相較之下，中國的情況又是另一番景象。當地將 AI 與高科技技術導入工廠及物流體系，帶動工業生產與出口競爭力雙雙提升。
國際金融協會（IIF）分析指出，數據中心建設、通訊設備生產等數位產業，如今已占中國 GDP 逾一成，近年更平均為整體經濟成長貢獻了將近 1 個百分點的動能。
不過，這股力道仍不足以填補房地產市場低迷所留下的內需缺口，「AI 提升生產力、進而帶動薪資成長」的良性循環，在中國也尚未真正成形。
與美國類似，中國在 AI 投資所需的高階晶片上同樣長期依賴進口，半導體貿易收支持續處於逆差狀態。
值得注意的是，真正嚐到甜頭的，反而是在半導體出口上具備優勢的南韓、台灣等經濟體。
國際貨幣基金（IMF）最新一期《世界經濟展望》顯示，南韓、台灣、泰國、馬來西亞今年第一季的 GDP 年化季增率，平均較 IMF 原先預測高出 4.4 個百分點。
其中南韓表現最為突出，季增年化率達 7.5%，足足是 IMF 預測值的四倍；台灣今年上半年出口額則較去年同期大增 47%，其中約八成來自伺服器、半導體等資訊科技設備，顯示 AI 需求的強勁拉動效應。
日本也可望在半導體製造設備與電子零組件出口上跟著沾光。野村證券經濟學家伊藤勇輝估算，若亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等美國科技巨頭依原訂計畫推進 2026 年的 AI 投資，日本相關出口有機會因此成長 17%。
外界普遍期待，這波 AI 熱潮能重現 1990 年代美國「無通膨式經濟成長」的榮景，長遠來看確實存在強勁拉抬美國經濟的可能性。
不過，市場同時也擔憂，AI 對企業獲利與生產力的實際改善程度，恐怕不如預期樂觀。
事實上，先前過熱的 AI 相關投機資金自 7 月起已出現逆轉跡象，全球股市中的 AI 與半導體概念股跌勢加劇，「AI 投資是否過熱」的疑慮正逐漸浮上檯面。
IMF 也提出警示，一旦市場對 AI 前景的預期降溫，除了美國、中國等投資主力國家之外，南韓等身為半導體供應鏈要角的經濟體，同樣可能面臨股市進入修正、股價下跌抑制消費動能的風險。
paras_en: In recent years the United States and China have poured astronomical sums into AI development, a wave now reflected in economic data worldwide, but the benefits have been uneven. While the US invests the most, its impact on economic growth is relatively modest; by contrast semiconductor-export powerhouses such as South Korea, Taiwan and Japan are enjoying short‑term growth dividends far beyond expectations.

According to Stanford University's Institute for Human‑Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI), private AI investment in the United States totaled $757.2 billion from 2013 to 2025, the highest in the world, with $285.8 billion poured in just in 2025—almost 40% of the cumulative total.
China follows with $131.8 billion, less than 20% of the US figure, though official fund contributions likely push the true amount higher.

Despite the flood of capital, the boost to US economic growth is less striking than the headline numbers suggest. Morgan Stanley estimates that AI‑related spending such as data‑center construction could lift US GDP growth by 1.37 percentage points, but because the advanced chips and communications gear needed are heavily imported, the net contribution after accounting for the drag from imports falls to only about 0.16 percentage points.

It is worth noting that as data‑center projects roll out, demand for cutting‑edge chips and servers outstrips supply, driving up prices and passing cost pressures onto products and services that rely on those components.

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has repeatedly stressed that AI diffusion will ultimately raise productivity and lower prices, but given current conditions the inflationary impact of expanding demand is far more evident.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller even warned that if AI investment continues to surge, it could become a new source of inflationary pressure.
China’s situation, by contrast, looks different. The country is integrating AI and high‑tech tools into factories and logistics, boosting both industrial output and export competitiveness.

The International Institute of Finance (IIF) notes that digital industries such as data‑center construction and communications equipment now account for more than 10% of China’s GDP and have contributed roughly 1 percentage point of growth momentum in recent years.

However, that force is still insufficient to fill the domestic‑demand gap left by a sluggish real‑estate market; the virtuous cycle of “AI raising productivity, which in turn lifts wages” has not yet materialised in China.
Like the United States, China also relies heavily on imported high‑end chips for AI investment, keeping its semiconductor trade balance in a persistent deficit.
The real beneficiaries are economies with semiconductor export advantages, such as South Korea and Taiwan.

The latest IMF World Economic Outlook shows that South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and Malaysia all posted first‑quarter 2024 GDP annualised growth rates that averaged 4.4 percentage points above the IMF’s own forecasts.

South Korea stood out with an annualised quarterly growth rate of 7.5%, four times the IMF’s estimate; Taiwan’s exports in the first half of the year jumped 47% year‑on‑year, about 80% of which came from servers, semiconductors and other IT equipment, underscoring the strong pull of AI demand.

Japan is also poised to benefit from semiconductor‑manufacturing equipment and electronic component exports. Nomura economist Yuuki Ito estimates that if US tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) proceed with their planned 2026 AI investments, Japan’s related exports could grow by as much as 17%.
Many expect this AI boom to recreate the 1990s US “growth without inflation” era, and in the long run it could indeed provide a powerful lift to the US economy.
Nevertheless, markets also worry that AI’s actual impact on corporate profits and productivity may fall short of optimistic expectations.

In fact, speculative AI‑related capital that had overheated began to reverse in July, with AI and semiconductor stocks falling faster in global markets, bringing the question of whether AI investment is over‑heated to the fore.

The IMF also warned that if market expectations for AI cool, not only the major investor nations like the US and China but also semiconductor‑chain economies such as South Korea could see stock‑market corrections and falling share prices that dampen consumer momentum.

items.title: AI光通訊需求爆發！祥茂光電財報報喜：800G營收暴增逾10倍、1.6T蓄勢放量
items.title_en: Applied Optoelectronics' Earnings Report Exceeds Expectations, Driven by Strong Demand for High-Speed Optical Communication Products
paras: 人工智慧（AI）資料中心持續擴大建置，帶動高速光通訊需求升溫，美國光模組廠商祥茂光電科技 (AAOI-US) 最新財報優於預期，成為週五（7 日）點燃整體光通訊族群行情的催化劑。市場解讀，祥茂光電強勁的資料中心業務表現，顯示 AI 算力基礎建設對高速光互聯產品的需求仍相當旺盛。
祥茂光電第 2 季營收達 1.919 億美元，年增 86%，其中資料中心業務營收首度突破 1 億美元；排除特殊項目後，每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.06 美元，不僅優於市場預期，也高於公司原先財測區間上緣。
展望第 3 季，祥茂光電預估營收將達 2.55 億至 2.90 億美元，並維持全年營收約 11 億美元的目標。
財報公布後，市場資金迅速湧入光通訊類股，Coherent(COHR-US) 股價單日大漲約 13%，Lumentum(LITE-US) 與康寧也分別上揚約 6% 及 5%，祥茂光電自身股價則走高約 9%。
分析師認為，祥茂光電財報不只是單一公司的利多，更可能替整個光通訊產業釋放正面訊號。由於 AI 資料中心持續擴張，伺服器、GPU 與交換器之間需要更高速率的資料傳輸，光學收發器因此成為 AI 基礎建設不可或缺的關鍵零組件。
Coherent、祥茂光電、Lumentum 與康寧 (GLW-US) 均深度布局相關市場，因此被市場視為 AI 基礎建設的「賣鏟人」概念股。
其中，Coherent 與 Lumentum 即將在下週公布最新財報，市場正密切觀察兩家公司能否複製祥茂光電的強勁表現。分析師預期，在 AI 資料中心需求持續強勁的情況下，兩家公司營收與獲利仍有望維持成長。
值得注意的是，Coherent 與 Lumentum 均與輝達 (NVDA-US) 存在資本或業務層面的連結，進一步提高市場對其 AI 光互聯布局的關注度。

400G 光模組仍是主力　800G 營收暴增逾 10 倍

從祥茂光電產品結構來看，資料中心業務的高速產品需求正在快速轉向更高傳輸速率。
第 2 季 400G 光模組營收達 4840 萬美元，年增超過 4 倍，目前仍是資料中心業務的重要收入來源。不過，相較之下，800G 產品的成長速度更加驚人。
祥茂光電第 2 季 800G 營收達 1280 萬美元，較去年同期大增逾 10 倍，較第 1 季更成長超過 1 倍。公司更預期，第 3 季 800G 營收將較第 2 季接近成長 5 倍。
這代表祥茂光電的資料中心產品組合正在快速升級，成長主軸將逐步從 100G、400G 等既有產品，轉向 800G 甚至 1.6T 等更高速率的光模組。

需求高於供給 20% 至 40%　產能成 AI 光模組最大瓶頸

祥茂光電管理層在財報電話會議中透露，目前客戶需求已經比公司的供應能力高出約 20% 至 40%，顯示市場需求並非當前限制營收成長的主要因素，真正的瓶頸反而落在產能擴張、關鍵零組件供應，以及新一代 1.6T 產品的客戶認證進度。
根據公司財務長 Stefan Murry，祥茂光電目前 800G 與 1.6T 產品的月產能接近 20 萬片，較第 1 季末約 10 萬片明顯增加。
祥茂光電預計，到 2026 年底月產能將超過 65 萬片，2027 年底進一步提升至超過 93 萬片，其中逾半產能將來自德州廠。
除了 800G 之外，1.6T 被視為祥茂光電下一個重要成長引擎。
公司管理層表示，祥茂光電即將成為某一家大型超大規模資料中心業者第 4 家通過 1.6T 產品認證的供應商，預計在未來 2 至 3 週內完成認證，並於第 3 季末開始出貨、第 4 季進一步放量。
祥茂光電執行長林誌祥預期，第 4 季 1.6T 光收發器營收將超過 7000 萬美元，並認為明年第 1 季仍有大幅成長空間，甚至不排除營收季增一倍。
從更長期來看，公司預估至 2027 年中，100G 與 400G 產品月營收約 9000 萬美元，800G 月營收約 2.17 億美元，1.6T 則可達約 1.64 億美元，資料中心光收發器合計月營收有望達到約 4.71 億美元。
不過，這項成長藍圖仍存在供應鏈與生產端風險，取決於設備安裝、客戶認證、材料供應和製造良率等多個條件協同推進。
祥茂光電坦承，1.6T 關鍵零件 DSP、TIA 供應仍較緊張，第四季度 1.6T 交付的主要約束來自材料而非產能本身。
paras_en: The continuous expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers has driven up demand for high-speed optical communication, and US-based optical module manufacturer Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) has released a better-than-expected earnings report, becoming a catalyst for the overall optical communication sector on Friday.

Applied Optoelectronics' second-quarter revenue reached $191.9 million, up 86% year-over-year, with data center business revenue exceeding $100 million for the first time; excluding special items, earnings per share (EPS) were $0.06, exceeding market expectations and the company's original forecast range.
Looking ahead to the third quarter, Applied Optoelectronics expects revenue to reach $255 million to $290 million and maintains its full-year revenue target of around $1.1 billion.

After the earnings report was released, market funds quickly flowed into optical communication stocks, with Coherent (COHR-US) stock price surging around 13%, Lumentum (LITE-US) and Corning rising around 6% and 5%, respectively, and Applied Optoelectronics' stock price rising around 9%.

Analysts believe that Applied Optoelectronics' earnings report is not only a positive factor for the company but also a positive signal for the entire optical communication industry, as AI data centers continue to expand, requiring higher-speed data transmission between servers, GPUs, and switches, making optical transceivers a crucial component.
Coherent, Applied Optoelectronics, Lumentum, and Corning (GLW-US) are all deeply invested in related markets and are seen by the market as 'pick-and-shovel' concept stocks for AI infrastructure.

Coherent and Lumentum are scheduled to release their latest earnings reports next week, and the market is closely watching to see if they can replicate Applied Optoelectronics' strong performance; analysts expect that if AI data center demand remains strong, the two companies' revenue and profits will continue to grow.
Notably, Coherent and Lumentum have capital or business ties with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), further increasing market attention to their AI optical interconnect layout.

400G optical modules remain the mainstay, while 800G revenue surges over 10 times; from Applied Optoelectronics' product structure, high-speed product demand in data center businesses is rapidly shifting towards higher transmission rates.

In the second quarter, 400G optical module revenue reached $48.4 million, up more than four times year-over-year, and remains an important source of revenue for data center businesses; however, 800G product growth is even more impressive.

Applied Optoelectronics' second-quarter 800G revenue reached $12.8 million, up over 10 times year-over-year and more than double the first quarter; the company expects third-quarter 800G revenue to grow nearly five times from the second quarter.
This represents a rapid upgrade of Applied Optoelectronics' data center product portfolio, with growth shifting from existing 100G and 400G products to higher-speed 800G and 1.6T optical modules.

Demand exceeds supply by 20% to 40%; production capacity is the biggest bottleneck for AI optical modules; Applied Optoelectronics' management revealed in the earnings conference call that customer demand has exceeded the company's supply capacity by around 20% to 40%, indicating that market demand is not the main factor limiting revenue growth, and the real bottleneck lies in production capacity expansion, key component supply, and customer certification for new 1.6T products.

According to the company's CFO, Stefan Murry, Applied Optoelectronics' current monthly production capacity for 800G and 1.6T products is close to 200,000 units, significantly increased from around 100,000 units at the end of the first quarter.

Applied Optoelectronics expects its monthly production capacity to exceed 650,000 units by the end of 2026 and over 930,000 units by the end of 2027, with more than half of the production capacity coming from its Texas factory.

In addition to 800G, 1.6T is seen as Applied Optoelectronics' next major growth engine; the company's management stated that Applied Optoelectronics is about to become the fourth supplier to pass 1.6T product certification for a large hyperscale data center operator, expecting to complete certification within the next 2-3 weeks and start shipping in the third quarter, with further expansion in the fourth quarter.

Applied Optoelectronics' CEO, Dr. Thompson Lin, expects 1.6T optical transceiver revenue to exceed $70 million in the fourth quarter and believes there is still significant growth potential in the first quarter of next year, not ruling out the possibility of revenue increasing by more than 100% quarter-over-quarter.

From a longer-term perspective, the company estimates that by mid-2027, 100G and 400G product monthly revenue will be around $90 million, 800G monthly revenue will be around $217 million, and 1.6T will reach around $164 million, with total data center optical transceiver monthly revenue expected to reach around $471 million.

However, this growth blueprint still carries supply chain and production risks, depending on the coordination of multiple conditions such as equipment installation, customer certification, material supply, and manufacturing yield.

Applied Optoelectronics admits that the supply of key components such as DSP and TIA for 1.6T products is still relatively tight, and the main constraint for 1.6T delivery in the fourth quarter comes from materials rather than production capacity itself.
The company is working to address these challenges and ensure a smooth ramp-up of its 1.6T products to meet growing customer demand.

items.title: 「席勒本益比」飆破42顯示美股恐崩盤？高盛：未來10年仍有7%報酬
items.title_en: S&P Shiller P/E Surpasses 42, Hinting at US Stock Crash? Goldman Sachs: 7% Returns Expected Over Next Decade
paras: 美股指標「席勒本益比」7 月突破 42，創 2000 年網路泡沫高峰以來新高，讓市場擔憂未來報酬恐大幅降溫。不過，專家提醒，高估值不等於股市即將崩盤，企業利潤率持續改善、AI 等產業結構轉變，都可能讓估值維持高檔更久，投資人真正需要警惕的，或許不是「高估值」，而是高估值背後的基本面能否持續支撐。
根據《Business Insider》報導，由於歷史上準確預測長期報酬的紀錄，席勒本益比向來受到看空派與主流華爾街策略師的青睞。
研究機構羅森伯格（Rosenberg Research）創辦人、向來立場偏空的羅森伯格（David Rosenberg）就在近日發布的客戶報告中直言，該指標顯示，若排除網路泡沫時期，目前標普 500 指數是「有史以來估值最昂貴」的時期。
幾年前，高盛集團 (GS-US) 前策略師 David Kostin 也曾警告，高企的 「席勒本益比」代表未來 10 年的年化報酬率可能僅有 3%。
分析稱，儘管席勒本益比原本並非設計用來預測短期市場走勢，但市場人士難免聯想到，指標上次觸及相近高點時，正好是股市崩跌的前夕。
報導指出，即便短期內未必爆發系統性風險，但「未來十年報酬近乎掛零」的前景，同樣令投資人不安。
不過，分析人士指出，這項指標並非毫無爭議，其侷限性也讓不少專家對「估值過高必然導致崩盤」的說法持保留態度，投資人或不必過度擔心。
從歷史數據即可看出席勒本益比一個明顯的缺陷，即美股估值長期處於高檔，指數卻屢創新高。
以 2021 年 7 月為例，當時席勒本益比來到 38。根據美國金融學院（The American College of Financial Services）財富管理教授 Michael Finke 2020 年的研究推算，這代表標普 500 未來十年年化報酬應僅有 1% 至 2%。
然而，過去五年間，標普 500 指數累計上漲 73%，換算年化報酬超過 14%，與當初估算的低報酬情境相差甚遠。
分析指出，除非未來爆發足以重創市場的極端事件，將整體平均報酬拉低至 1% 至 2% 區間，否則單純因估值過高而退場觀望，恐怕反而付出高昂的機會成本。
富達投資（Fidelity）2024 年的一份研究報告也支持這項觀點。該報告發現，若以高本益比為起點的十年期間出現不佳報酬，往往是因為期間爆發如二戰或金融海嘯等重大危機所致，而非估值本身必然導致報酬下滑。
分析人士並提醒，除非投資人正好處於退休前十年、或近期即需動用資金，否則多數人毋須過度憂慮估值偏高的問題，長期複利股息效果，往往足以彌補階段性報酬疲弱的影響。
此外，席勒本益比的另一項局限在於「過於仰賴過去」。由於該指標是以當前股價對比過去十年滾動平均獲利計算而成，往往難以即時反映市場結構的重大轉變。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 便是典型案例。過去四年，AI 需求爆發式成長，大幅推升該公司價值，但若仍以 2022 年 AI 浪潮興起前的十年平均獲利作為比較基準，顯然難以合理反映輝達當前的真實價值。
高盛首席美股策略師史奈德（Ben Snider）今年 6 月接受訪問時則提出另一種觀點。儘管目前的席勒本益比水準隱含未來報酬可能為負，他仍預期標普 500 指數未來十年年化報酬可望達到 7%。
這是因為，史奈德認為企業高估值狀態可能維持更長時間。他指出，過去幾十年來企業利潤率持續走高，從 2000 年的 7% 一路升至目前約 13%。
Snider 表示：「這些利潤率似乎不太可能回落至長期平均水準，因此，認為估值倍數應該回歸長期平均值的假設，似乎也不是一個很有說服力的論點。」
paras_en: The Shiller P/E ratio, a key US stock market indicator, broke above 42 in July, reaching its highest level since the 2000 dot‑com bubble peak, sparking concerns that future returns could cool sharply. However, experts caution that a high valuation does not automatically mean a market crash; continued improvement in corporate profit margins and structural shifts such as AI could keep valuations elevated for longer, and investors should focus more on whether the fundamentals behind the high valuation can be sustained.

According to Business Insider, the Shiller P/E has long been favored by bearish investors and mainstream Wall Street strategists because of its historically accurate record in forecasting long‑term returns.

David Rosenberg, founder of Rosenberg Research and traditionally bearish, wrote in a recent client note that, excluding the dot‑com bubble period, the S&P 500 is currently at the "most expensive valuation in history."
A few years ago, former Goldman Sachs strategist David Kostin warned that a lofty Shiller P/E implies an annualized return of only about 3% over the next ten years.

Analysts note that although the Shiller P/E was not designed to predict short‑term market moves, market participants inevitably recall that the last time the indicator approached a similar high, a market collapse was imminent.
The report adds that even if systemic risk does not materialize in the short term, the prospect of "near‑zero returns over the next decade" still unsettles investors.

Nevertheless, analysts point out that the metric is not without controversy; its limitations lead many experts to be skeptical of the claim that "overvaluation inevitably leads to a crash," suggesting investors need not be overly worried.
Historical data reveal a clear flaw in the Shiller P/E: US equity valuations have stayed high for long periods while the index repeatedly hits new highs.

For example, in July 2021 the Shiller P/E was 38. Based on a 2020 study by Michael Finke, a wealth‑management professor at The American College of Financial Services, this implied an expected annualized return of only 1%‑2% for the S&P 500 over the next ten years.
Yet over the past five years the S&P 500 has risen 73% cumulatively, translating to an annualized return of over 14%, far above the low‑return scenario originally projected.

Analysts argue that unless an extreme event occurs that drags average returns down to the 1%‑2% range, exiting the market merely because valuations are high would likely incur a hefty opportunity cost.

A 2024 Fidelity research report supports this view, finding that ten‑year periods that start with high P/E ratios only underperform when major crises such as World War II or the financial crisis erupt, not because high valuation alone causes lower returns.

Analysts also warn that unless investors are within ten years of retirement or need to draw on funds soon, most people need not be overly concerned about elevated valuations; long‑term compounding of dividends usually offsets temporary return weakness.

Another limitation of the Shiller P/E is its heavy reliance on the past; because it compares current prices to a ten‑year rolling average of earnings, it often fails to capture rapid structural changes in the market.

Nvidia (NVDA) is a prime example. Over the past four years, explosive AI demand has dramatically boosted the company's value, yet using the pre‑AI‑boom ten‑year average earnings from 2022 as a benchmark does not fairly reflect Nvidia's current true worth.

Goldman Sachs chief US equity strategist Ben Snider, in a June interview, offered a different perspective. Although the current Shiller P/E level suggests future returns could be negative, he still expects the S&P 500 to deliver a 7% annualized return over the next decade.

Snider argues that high corporate valuations may persist longer than expected. He notes that corporate profit margins have risen steadily over the past decades, climbing from 7% in 2000 to roughly 13% today.

Snider said, "These profit margins seem unlikely to revert to long‑term average levels, so the assumption that valuation multiples should fall back to their historical averages is not a very persuasive argument."

items.title: 美國期中選舉恐成美股牛市「轉折點」！美銀警告：AI泡沫或被戳破
items.title_en: US Midterm Election Could Be the Turning Point of the Stock Bull Market, Bank of America Warns AI Bubble May Burst
paras: 美國銀行策略團隊示警，這波牛市可能在數個月後遭遇重大考驗，而風險來源正是 11 月即將登場的期中選舉。
根據《Business Insider》報導，由哈奈特（Michael Hartnett）領軍的策略團隊在最新報告中指出，隨著 11 月期中選舉落幕，美股可能面臨一波「大幅」反轉風險。
該行近期發布給客戶的報告指出，此次選舉可能演變成一場「民粹資本主義與民粹社會主義之間的公投」，因此不排除民主黨全面拿下國會的可能性。
團隊在報告中建議投資人短期內應避開高風險資產，轉向防禦性投資部位，並看好黃金作為對沖工具，用以因應「K 型經濟」與選民對經濟不滿情緒所帶來的雙重風險。
所謂 K 型經濟，指的是高收入族群與中低收入家庭之間日益擴大的貧富差距。儘管股市與房市上漲讓高所得者財富持續累積，許多中低收入美國人卻正承受通膨升溫與就業市場疲軟的雙重壓力。
美銀策略師進一步分析，近期經濟成長主要仰賴股市上漲所帶動的財富效應。過去兩年間，投資人累積的市場獲利高達 9 兆美元，若股市出現逆轉，帳面財富縮水恐讓消費者轉趨保守，進而拖累整體經濟成長。
除了選舉變數，美銀也點出公債殖利率走升的潛在威脅。隨著投資人對通膨與美國財政前景的憂慮加深，殖利率若持續攀升，在最壞情況下恐嚴重壓抑風險性資產，甚至戳破外界擔憂已久的 AI 泡沫。
策略師表示：「每一輪繁榮與泡沫，最終往往都是由債券市場終結；一旦出現『殖利率走高、美元走弱』的警示事件，迫使財政政策急轉彎，以及資產配置從股票轉向債券，當前的泡沫就會結束。」
他們並將殖利率形容為目前最值得關注的「礦坑裡的金絲雀」。
事實上，殖利率已因通膨數據升溫而開始走高，但目前市場仍能消化這波漲勢。目前 10 年期美國公債殖利率約落在 4.67% 附近，高於投資人密切關注的 4.5% 心理關卡。
華爾街其他機構同樣預警，隨著期中選舉逼近，市場波動恐將加劇。
奧本海默（Oppenheimer）分析師先前即指出，在總統邁入第二任期的期中選舉年份，標普 500 指數往往會在第三季出現回檔修正。
高盛策略師的歷史數據則顯示，自 1974 年以來的所有期中選舉年，標普 500 指數從 8 月 1 日到 11 月投票日期間的報酬率中位數為 0％。
paras_en: Bank of America’s strategy team warns that this bull market could face a major test in a few months, with the risk coming from the upcoming November midterm elections.

According to Business Insider, the strategy team led by Michael Hartnett noted in its latest report that the US equity market could face a “significant” reversal risk once the November midterms conclude.

The bank’s recent client report says the election could turn into a referendum between populist capitalism and populist socialism, and therefore does not rule out the possibility of Democrats taking full control of Congress.

The team advises investors to steer clear of high‑risk assets in the short term, shift to defensive positions, and view gold favorably as a hedge against the dual risks of a “K‑shaped” economy and voter dissatisfaction with the economy.

A “K‑shaped” economy refers to the widening wealth gap between high‑income earners and middle‑to‑low‑income households; while stock and housing price gains continue to build wealth for the affluent, many middle‑ and low‑income Americans are feeling the twin pressures of rising inflation and a weak job market.

Bank of America strategists further analyze that recent economic growth has been largely driven by a wealth effect from rising stock prices. Over the past two years, investors have accumulated about $9 trillion in market gains, and a market reversal could shrink paper wealth, prompting consumers to become more cautious and dragging down overall economic growth.

Beyond the election variable, BofA also points to the potential threat of rising government‑bond yields. As investors grow more concerned about inflation and US fiscal outlook, continued yield increases could, in the worst case, severely suppress risk assets and even burst the long‑standing AI bubble concerns.

The strategists say, “Each cycle of prosperity and bubble ultimately ends in the bond market; once a ‘rising yields, weakening dollar’ warning materializes, it forces fiscal policy to pivot and asset allocation to shift from stocks to bonds, ending the current bubble.”
They describe yields as the most closely watched “canary in the coal mine” right now.

In fact, yields have already started to climb as inflation data heats up, but the market is still able to absorb the rise. The 10‑year US Treasury yield is currently around 4.67%, above the 4.5% psychological threshold investors watch closely.
Other Wall Street firms are issuing similar warnings, noting that market volatility could intensify as the midterms approach.
Oppenheimer analysts previously pointed out that in midterm election years when a president is in a second term, the S&P 500 often experiences a pull‑back correction in the third quarter.
Goldman Sachs strategists’ historical data show that for every midterm election year since 1974, the median return of the S&P 500 from August 1 to the November voting date has been 0 %.

items.title: 美股上漲卻更「便宜」了？標普500漲22%估值反降、企業獲利成大推手
items.title_en: US Stocks Rise, But Become Cheaper? S&P 500 Up 22% as Valuation Falls, Earnings Drive the Market
paras: 在「縮水式通膨」（shrinkflation）當道的年代，消費者早已習慣商品份量悄悄縮水、內容物偷工減料的失望滋味，同樣的價錢，買到的巧克力花生醬杯裡，可能只剩「巧克力糖」與「花生醬奶油」充數。然而，在股票市場上，投資人此刻卻意外享受到「加量不加價」的待遇。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，過去一年，標普 500 指數大漲 22%，但股票估值非但沒有跟著墊高，反而下滑。
根據彭博資訊統計，該指數的預期本益比已從 22.1 倍降至 20 倍左右。換言之，投資人如今花更少的錢，卻能買到更有價值的東西。
分析指出，造成這種現象的關鍵，在於企業「獲利」的成長速度，明顯超越「股價」的漲幅。
根據 FactSet 統計，第二季財報季的表現可謂相當驚人，有 86% 的企業財報獲利優於市場預期，高於 78% 的平均水準；此外，標普 500 指數成分股第二季獲利較去年同期大幅成長 50.4%。
不過，這波獲利榮景並非僅靠人工智慧（AI）題材撐場。Evercore ISI 的 Julian Emanuel 指出：「第二季財報進一步印證科技與能源產業的強勁表現，但更令人意外的是，獲利成長的力道已廣泛擴散至各產業及產業內的不同領域。」
更重要的是，這波強勁表現預料仍可延續。分析師向來有在新一季開始前下修獲利預期的「慣例」，但這一次卻出現反常情況，市場不僅沒有下調預測，反而將第三季獲利預期上修 0.3%。
然而，這股「一路看漲」的氛圍，也讓部分投資專家開始警覺。Verdence Capital Advisors 首席投資長 Megan Horneman 坦言，這季財報表現確實驚豔，但問題在於「調升獲利預期似乎沒有盡頭」，這種現象恐怕透露出市場已出現「自滿心理」。
不過，也有市場人士對這些獲利的「品質」抱持疑慮。做空投資人 Jim Chanos 認為，AI 支出的會計處理方式可能在一定程度上美化企業獲利，原因在於設備供應商能更快認列營收，但採購設備的企業則需要較長時間才能將相關支出反映在費用中。
這或許能部分解釋，為何科技產業的本益比降幅較整體大盤更為明顯。不過，獲利成長並非僅集中在 AI 相關產業，整體市場的企業獲利表現相當廣泛。就連非 AI 產業，例如民生必需品類股，過去一年股價也有所上漲，且並未同步推升估值水準。
也有觀點認為，企業獲利成長幅度過於強勁，已使短期估值指標失去參考意義。
Rosenberg Research 的 David Rosenberg 指出，Robert Shiller 提出的「席勒本益比」（CAPE），也就是以標普 500 指數當前價格，對比過去 10 年平均獲利的估值指標，目前已升至網路泡沫時期以來少見的高位。
不過，遠期本益比（Forward P/E）與 CAPE 之間的落差，其實透露出另一個訊息：市場預期企業未來一年的獲利，將遠高於過去 10 年的平均水準，讓人不禁反思，以「網路泡沫時代」的獲利基準來衡量今日的企業表現，是否本身就已經不合時宜？
不過，市場疑慮並未因此完全消散。
儘管亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與 Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等 AI 相關投資大戶，因為從雲端業務中賺進可觀營收，使科技股自七月低點反彈約 12%，但分析師提醒，這並不代表企業投入的每一分 AI 支出，最終都能轉化為實質報酬。
paras_en: In the era of 'shrinkflation', consumers have grown accustomed to the disappointment of goods shrinking in size and quality while prices remain the same. However, investors in the stock market are experiencing the opposite - 'more for less'.
According to Bloomberg, the S&P 500 index has risen 22% over the past year, but stock valuations have not followed suit, instead falling.
According to Bloomberg data, the index's expected price-to-earnings ratio has dropped from 22.1 to around 20. This means investors are now paying less for more valuable stocks.
Analysts attribute this phenomenon to the growth rate of corporate earnings, which has outpaced stock price gains.

According to FactSet, 86% of companies in the second quarter reported earnings that beat market expectations, exceeding the average of 78%. The S&P 500 index's constituent stocks also saw a 50.4% year-over-year increase in earnings in the second quarter.

However, this earnings boom is not solely driven by AI-related themes. Evercore ISI's Julian Emanuel notes that the second-quarter earnings reports have further confirmed the strong performance of the tech and energy sectors, but more surprisingly, earnings growth has spread to various industries and sub-sectors.

More importantly, this strong performance is expected to continue. Analysts have traditionally lowered earnings expectations before the start of a new quarter, but this time, the market has not only avoided lowering expectations but has even raised third-quarter earnings expectations by 0.3%.

However, this 'one-way bet' atmosphere has also raised concerns among some investment experts. Verdence Capital Advisors' Chief Investment Officer Megan Horneman notes that this quarter's earnings reports have been impressive, but the problem lies in the fact that 'the upward revision of earnings expectations seems to have no end', which may indicate that the market has become complacent.

However, some market participants have raised concerns about the 'quality' of these earnings. Short-seller Jim Chanos believes that the accounting treatment of AI-related expenses may have artificially inflated corporate earnings, as equipment suppliers can quickly recognize revenue, while companies that purchase equipment take longer to reflect related expenses in their costs.

This may help explain why the tech sector's price-to-earnings ratio has fallen more sharply than the overall market. However, earnings growth is not limited to AI-related industries, and the overall market's corporate earnings performance has been quite broad. Even non-AI industries, such as consumer staples, have seen their stock prices rise over the past year without a corresponding increase in valuation.
Some argue that corporate earnings growth has become so strong that short-term valuation metrics have lost their relevance.

Rosenberg Research's David Rosenberg notes that the 'Shiller P/E' (CAPE), which compares the current price of the S&P 500 index to its average earnings over the past 10 years, has risen to a level not seen since the dot-com bubble.

However, the gap between the forward P/E and CAPE actually reveals another message: the market expects corporate earnings to be significantly higher than their 10-year average in the coming year, raising questions about whether today's corporate performance is being measured against an outdated benchmark.
However, market concerns have not been completely alleviated.

Despite Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) - parent company of Google - AI-related heavyweights experiencing a 12% rebound from their July lows due to cloud business revenue, analysts caution that not every dollar invested in AI will necessarily translate to tangible returns.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美國通膨數據、英國GDP與澳洲利率決策
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: US Inflation Data, UK GDP, and Australian Rate Decision
paras: 本週財經焦點將圍繞美國 7 月消費者物價指數 (CPI)、生產者物價指數 (PPI) 與零售銷售數據，國際市場上，澳洲央行 (RBA) 利率決策，以及英國第二季 GDP 初估值均受到關注。

本週操盤筆記 (0809-0815)

1, 美國通膨數據
本週最受矚目的為美國 7 月 CPI 及 PPI，根據克里夫蘭聯準會的「通膨即時預測」(Inflation Nowcasting) 模型，7 月 CPI 年增率預計將從 6 月的 3.5% 小幅下滑至 3.4%，月增率則為 0.1%。核心 CPI(扣除食品與能源) 年增率則預計降至 2.5%。
儘管市場預期通膨壓力略有減緩，但經濟學家仍保持警惕。巴克萊銀行 (Barclays) 經濟學家 Pooja Sriram 指出，即便油價下跌，但在服務業類別的帶動下，7 月 CPI 可能會出現小幅反彈，核心 CPI 月增率或達 0.24%。若數據符合預期，聯準會內部傾向中立的官員可能會選擇在 8 月份數據出爐前繼續維持利率不變，但若通膨意外走高，升息壓力將再度升溫。
2. 美國消費韌性
除了通膨，7 月零售銷售數據也是觀測美國經濟健康程度的關鍵。雖然就業數據放緩，但 6 月零售銷售年增率仍達 6.7%，顯示消費者支出依舊穩健。
目前市場預測 7 月零售銷售將月增 0.2%，與前月持平。本週還將公佈 8 月密西根大學消費者信心指數初步值，投資者將從中尋找消費者對未來經濟與通膨預期的最新信號。
3. 全球利率決策
本週澳洲央行預計將維持關鍵利率於 4.35%，主因是第二季通膨已有所降溫。日本央行將發布 7 月會議意見摘要。由於日元近期面臨巨大的貶值壓力，加上 6 月 PPI 年增率跳升至 7.1%，市場正高度關注日本是否會透過緊縮政策來支撐匯率。
4. 歐洲經濟成長表現
歐洲方面，英國將發布第二季 GDP 初估值，市場預期成長 0.4%。製造業產出預計將出現 4 個月來的首次下降。同時，根據英國零售商協會的數據，英國 7 月零售銷售額預計將年增 1.5%，低於 6 月的 1.7%。
歐元區工業生產預計將反彈，過去 5 個月中有 4 個月實現成長。
5. 重要企業財報
本週財報焦點將由網路通訊巨頭思科 (CSCO-US) 領銜，思科今年以來股價表現強勁，漲幅達 58%，成為道瓊工業指數中表現最佳的公司，市值已攀升至 4,780 億美元。這波漲勢主要受惠於其在人工智慧 (AI) 產業的關鍵地位，為微軟 (MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US) 與 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 等科技巨頭提供交換機、路由器及光學元件等網路解決方案。
paras_en: This week’s financial focus will revolve around the United States July Consumer Price Index (CPI), Producer Price Index (PPI) and retail sales data, as well as the Australian Reserve Bank’s (RBA) rate decision and the UK’s second‑quarter GDP preliminary estimate on the international markets.

This week’s trading notes (0809‑0815)

1. US inflation data

The most watched items this week are the US July CPI and PPI. According to the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland’s “Inflation Nowcasting” model, the July CPI annual rate is expected to slip slightly from June’s 3.5% to 3.4%, with a monthly increase of 0.1%. Core CPI (excluding food and energy) is projected to fall to a 2.5% annual rise.

Although the market expects a modest easing of inflation pressure, economists remain cautious. Barclays economist Pooja Sriram notes that even with lower oil prices, the services sector could cause a small rebound in July CPI, and core CPI’s monthly rise could reach 0.24%. If the data meet expectations, Fed officials who lean neutral may keep rates unchanged until the August data release, but an unexpected inflation uptick would revive rate‑hike pressure.
2. US consumer resilience

Beyond inflation, July retail sales data are also a key gauge of US economic health. Despite a slowdown in employment, June retail sales grew 6.7% year‑over‑year, indicating that consumer spending remains robust.

The market currently forecasts a 0.2% month‑over‑month increase in July retail sales, flat with the prior month. This week will also see the release of the preliminary August University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment index, from which investors will look for fresh signals on consumer expectations for the economy and inflation.
3. Global rate decisions

The Australian Reserve Bank is expected to keep its policy rate at 4.35% this week, mainly because second‑quarter inflation has cooled. The Bank of Japan will publish a summary of its July meeting minutes. With the yen under significant depreciation pressure and June PPI annual growth jumping to 7.1%, markets are closely watching whether Japan will adopt tightening measures to support the currency.
4. European economic growth performance

In Europe, the UK will release its second‑quarter GDP preliminary estimate, with markets expecting 0.4% growth. Manufacturing output is projected to record its first decline in four months. At the same time, data from the British Retail Consortium show that UK July retail sales are expected to rise 1.5% year‑over‑year, down from June’s 1.7%.
Euro‑area industrial production is expected to rebound, with four out of the past five months showing growth.
5. Important corporate earnings

This week’s earnings spotlight will be led by networking giant Cisco (CSCO‑US). Cisco’s stock has performed strongly this year, up 58%, making it the top performer in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, with market capitalization now at $478 billion. The rally is largely driven by its pivotal role in the artificial‑intelligence (AI) sector, supplying switches, routers and optical components to tech giants such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US).

items.title: 加拿大野火快速蔓延 2萬人連夜逃命
items.title_en: Wildfires in British Columbia, Canada, Spread Rapidly, Forcing 20,000 to Flee Overnight
paras: 加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省境內野火快速蔓延，當地政府 8 日（周六）宣布啟動緊急狀態，超過 2 萬人零時左右收到緊急疏散令，連夜撤離家園。
尤其讓人擔憂的是，野火催生的火積雲產生閃電，劈向地面後誘發次生野火，導致火勢更加迅猛，走向難測。
不列顛哥倫比亞省政府 8 日宣布全省進入緊急狀態，疏散令涵蓋薩默蘭、皮奇蘭等地區，逾 2 萬人連夜逃命。2021 年人口普查數據顯示，薩默蘭地區人口約 1.2 萬人，皮奇蘭地區約 6,500 人。
薩默蘭區居民特里 · 弗里斯 7 日晚本來在家裡看球賽轉播，鄰居提醒他收拾行李，躲避野火。弗里斯告訴《路透社》：「當時野火離我們還比較遠，我們能看見山後方有大火。」午夜時分，省政府下達疏散令，這家人趕緊向北驅車約 45 公里，逃至基洛納。
像弗裡斯一家那樣，許多居民連夜撤離，駕車沿高速公路或向南逃往彭蒂克頓，或向北趕往基洛納。隨著火勢擴散，一夜之間過火面積近乎翻倍，附近高速公路陸續封閉。
不列顛哥倫比亞省省長戴維 · 伊比 8 日說，「已有大量房屋與財產遭損毀」，「火情發展極快，導致部分民眾受困」，「正在進行空中救援」。
據加拿大電視網報導，福爾德社區有 50 多人受困，當局出動直升機成功救出。
現場畫面顯示，截至 8 日下午，大片地區的建築物被野火點燃，汽車、房屋被灰燼覆蓋，天空被火光染成橘紅色。
火勢較為嚴峻的薩默蘭區 8 日斷電。受野火影響，未經處理的水進入當地自來水供水系統，給公共衛生造成威脅。市政部門發布公告，提醒居民飲水需煮沸。
本輪野火肆虐區域是加拿大第二大葡萄酒產區。野火對當地帶來的經濟損失尚待評估。
這輪野火 7 日傍晚首次被通報。因受大風助推，野火快速蔓延。截至 8 日下午，過火面積已達 9,500 公頃。
paras_en: Wildfires in British Columbia, Canada, are spreading rapidly, prompting the local government to declare a state of emergency on August 6. More than 20,000 people received an emergency evacuation order and fled their homes overnight.

The rapid spread of the wildfires is particularly concerning, as they are generating pyrocumulonimbus clouds that produce lightning, which then ignites secondary wildfires, making the situation even more unpredictable.

The British Columbia government declared a province-wide state of emergency on August 6, with evacuation orders covering areas including Summerland and Penticton, affecting more than 20,000 people. According to the 2021 census, Summerland has a population of approximately 12,000, while Penticton has around 6,500 residents.

Summerland resident Terry Freis was watching a sports broadcast at home on the evening of August 5 when his neighbor reminded him to pack his bags and evacuate due to the wildfires. Freis told Reuters, "The fire was still a ways off from us, and we could see the flames behind the mountains." By midnight, the provincial government issued an evacuation order, and this family quickly drove north for about 45 kilometers to Kelowna.

Like Freis' family, many residents fled their homes overnight, driving along highways or heading south to Penticton or north to Kelowna. As the fire spread, the area affected by the fire nearly doubled overnight, with several highways being closed.

British Columbia Premier David Eby said on August 6, "There has been significant damage to homes and property," "The fire is spreading very quickly, leaving some people stranded," "We are conducting air rescues."
According to Canadian television reports, over 50 people were trapped in the community of Falkland, but were successfully rescued by helicopter.
On-site footage showed that by the afternoon of August 6, large areas of buildings were on fire, cars and houses were covered in ash, and the sky was orange-red due to the flames.

The Summerland area, which is particularly affected by the fire, lost power on August 6. Due to the wildfires, untreated water entered the local water supply system, posing a threat to public health. The municipal department issued a notice reminding residents to boil their water before consumption.
The region affected by the wildfires is Canada's second-largest wine-producing region. The economic losses caused by the wildfires are still being assessed.
The wildfires were first reported on the evening of August 5. Due to strong winds, the fires spread rapidly. By the afternoon of August 6, the area affected by the fires had reached 9,500 hectares.

items.title: 華爾街日報：蘋果測試長鑫存儲記憶體晶片 用於iPhone、MacBook
items.title_en: Apple Tests Longxin Memory Chips for iPhones and MacBooks
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 正在 iPhone、MacBook 等產品線中測試長鑫存儲（CXMT）的記憶體晶片，以緩解人工智慧（AI）熱潮引發的記憶體短缺問題。
據《華爾街日報》9 日（周日）報導，知情人士透露，蘋果已與中國最大晶片製造商長鑫存儲就零件供應展開初步洽談，目標是在中國銷售的部分裝置中使用這些晶片。
蘋果在與長鑫存儲達成任何協議之前，正積極尋求白宮批准。
不過，長鑫儲存並非蘋果的萬靈丹。消息人士表示，長鑫存儲今年的產能已達極限，幾乎沒有空間接新國際客戶。
知情人士提到，長鑫儲存許多產品的價格已與美光（Micron）(MU-US) 、SK 海力士、三星電子差不多，偶爾甚至賣得比較貴。他們說，這種定價策略部分是因為長鑫儲存供應吃緊，且生產成本比國外競爭對手高。
此舉的背景是蘋果近期調漲產品售價，並將此歸因於 AI 公司龐大需求推高記憶體晶片成本。蘋果若能從中國製造商處確保穩定供應，將有助蘋果在成本壓力上獲得更大議價空間。
根據美國聯邦法規，美國企業被禁止與長鑫存儲共享技術，包括在晶片規格方面的技術交流，而這類交流通常是生產蘋果客製化晶片的必要環節。這項限制實際上阻礙了蘋果向長鑫儲存採購客製化晶片。
部分美國政策制定者擔心，如果長鑫儲存獲得美國頂尖企業的訂單，將獲得美國的專業技術和更多資金來推進其技術。他們指出，這可能會協助北京當局推動軍事發展，並打擊美光。
筆電製造商惠普（HP）和宏碁（Acer）已開始在銷往美國以外市場的裝置中使用長鑫存儲的晶片，以緩解供應短缺。
paras_en: Apple Inc. (AAPL-US) is testing memory chips from Longxin Storage (CXMT) for use in its iPhone and MacBook product lines to alleviate a shortage of memory caused by the surge in demand for artificial intelligence (AI).

According to a report by The Wall Street Journal on Sunday, Apple has begun preliminary talks with China's largest chip maker, Longxin Storage, to supply components, with the goal of using these chips in some devices sold in China.
Before reaching any agreement with Longxin Storage, Apple is actively seeking approval from the White House.
However, Longxin Storage is not Apple's panacea. Sources say that Longxin Storage's production capacity has reached its limit this year, leaving little room for new international customers.

Sources point out that Longxin Storage's prices for many products are similar to those of Micron (MU-US), SK Hynix, and Samsung Electronics, and sometimes even higher. They attribute this pricing strategy to the fact that Longxin Storage's supply is tight and its production costs are higher than those of its foreign competitors.

The move comes as Apple has recently raised prices for its products, attributing the increase to the surge in demand for AI companies, which has driven up the cost of memory chips. If Apple can secure stable supplies from Chinese manufacturers, it will help Apple gain more negotiating power on costs.

Under US federal regulations, US companies are prohibited from sharing technology with Longxin Storage, including exchanging technical information on chip specifications, which is typically a necessary step in producing customized chips for Apple. This restriction effectively blocks Apple from purchasing customized chips from Longxin Storage.

Some US policymakers are concerned that if Longxin Storage secures orders from top US companies, it will gain access to US expertise and more funding to advance its technology, which could help Beijing advance its military development and undermine Micron.
Laptop manufacturers HP and Acer have already begun using Longxin Storage's chips in devices sold outside the US to alleviate supply shortages.

items.title: 韓股暴跌40%後迎轉機？去槓桿完成過半、KOSPI估值創歷史新低
items.title_en: Korean Stocks See a Turning Point After 40% Plunge? Over Half of Leverage Positions Cleared, KOSPI Hits Historic Low
paras: 歷經今年以來最慘烈的一波拋售與強制平倉洗禮後，南韓股市的動盪似乎正逐漸降溫。隨著槓桿部位加速出清，加上監管機關祭出新規限制高風險商品交易，韓股波動率指數自六月創下歷史新高後，上週已滑落至近兩個月低點。
韓股此前的劇烈震盪，很大程度上是由槓桿交易泡沫所推升，而摩根士丹利分析指出，這波去槓桿進程目前已完成過半。
數據顯示，自六月高點以來，韓國綜合指數（KOSPI）最大跌幅一度逼近 40%；今年以來，海外資金累計賣超韓股金額已突破 1,000 億美元，新興市場基金對韓股的配置比重明顯偏低。
儘管波動趨緩，海外機構投資人卻未急於進場撿便宜。多位基金經理坦言，目前的波動率雖已從高點回落，但仍處於相對高檔，投資人必須在歷史低檔的估值、轉佳的獲利展望，與市場恐再度劇烈震盪的風險之間，尋求平衡。
新加坡安本亞洲收益基金高級投資總監艾薩克 · 通表示，其對韓股的態度已轉趨樂觀，但尚未到全然安心的地步，「唯有預期報酬率高到足以彌補目前的波動風險，市場才會出現真正意義上的好轉，我們仍在等待這一刻」。
回顧這波動盪，韓國波動率指數六月一度飆破 96.9 的歷史高位，相較 2025 年底的 28.9，漲幅驚人。
上個月，韓股更四度觸發 8% 跌幅熔斷機制，暫停交易 20 分鐘；韓國綜合指數近半數交易日的漲跌幅超過 5%，其中 7 月 31 日大盤單日暴漲 18%，締造史上最大單日漲幅紀錄。
面對如此劇烈的行情擺盪，南韓監管機關陸續出手。7 月 31 日，當局調高單一個股槓桿 ETF 的現金保證金門檻，使與三星電子 (005930KS) 、SK 海力士 (000660KS) 掛鉤的相關基金，交易量與資產規模應聲下滑。
監管單位並表態，未來將持續推出更多措施，抑制市場對高槓桿商品的投資需求。
在股市重挫與監管收緊的雙重壓力下，大批先前被行情吸引進場的散戶投資人遭到市場「洗出」。
根據韓國金融投資協會統計，六月散戶帳戶遭強制平倉的規模約達 1 兆韓元（約 7.1 億美元），七月則為 9,930 億韓元，是今年強制平倉金額最高的兩個月。
截至 8 月 4 日，用於股票交易的融資餘額降至 27.4 兆韓元，寫下今年以來新低。
杜拜 Arkevium 資本首席投資長維索認為，韓股市場結構正從散戶主導，逐步轉向由海外機構主導，「但僅憑幾個交易日的平穩表現還遠遠不夠，海外投資機構需要看到市場價格發現機制恢復正常運作的確切證據」。
在這波賣壓後，韓股部分估值指標已跌至相對低位，韓國綜合指數的 12 個月前瞻本益比降至 5.1 倍，創下歷史新低，但這樣的低估值，目前仍未能吸引資金大舉回流。
回顧今年稍早，受惠於 AI 晶片熱潮，韓股曾出現一波強勁漲勢，但過高的波動率，加上市場高度集中於三星電子與 SK 海力士兩大晶片巨頭，也讓這波漲勢埋下泡沫化的隱憂。
新加坡鄧普頓環球投資基金經理廖怡萍指出，三星電子與 SK 海力士目前的估值確實偏低，獲利展望依舊正向，「但居高不下的市場波動，讓短線投資人變得更加謹慎，面對如此劇烈的行情起伏，資金不會大規模快速回流，只會呈現小額分批進場的態勢」。
交易所數據亦顯示，外資撤離韓股的速度雖已放緩，但賣壓尚未止歇。繼六月創下 300 億美元的單月淨賣超紀錄後，七月外資淨賣超 62 億美元，八月以來則已淨賣超 43 億美元。
儘管如此，市場上仍不乏樂觀聲音。高盛本週重申韓國綜合指數未來 12 個月的目標點位為 12,000 點，較上週五收盤點位仍有約 90% 的上漲空間。
paras_en: South Korea's stock market has seen a significant decline in volatility after experiencing its most brutal sell-off and forced liquidation this year. As leverage positions are being cleared at an accelerated pace, and regulatory bodies introduce new rules to restrict high-risk trading, the KOSPI index has fallen to near two-month lows since reaching a historic high in June.

The previous extreme fluctuations in the Korean stock market were largely driven by leverage trading bubbles, according to Morgan Stanley's analysis. The current leverage reduction process has already completed over half of its progress.

Data shows that since June's peak, the KOSPI index has fallen by as much as 40%, while foreign investors have sold a cumulative $1 trillion worth of Korean stocks this year, with emerging market funds showing a significantly lower allocation to Korean stocks.

Despite the decline in volatility, institutional investors have yet to rush in to take advantage of the situation. Several fund managers have stated that while the volatility has decreased from its peak, it remains relatively high, and investors must balance the historic low valuations, improving profit outlooks, and the risk of further extreme fluctuations in the market.

Isaac Tong, Senior Investment Director at Singapore-based Asia-Pacific Income Fund, has expressed a more optimistic view on Korean stocks but still remains cautious, stating that "only when expected returns are high enough to compensate for the current volatility risk will the market truly experience a turnaround, and we are still waiting for that moment".
Looking back, the Korean volatility index reached a historic high of 96.9 in June, a staggering increase from 28.9 in December 2025.

Last month, the Korean stock market triggered the 8% decline circuit breaker four times, temporarily halting trading for 20 minutes, while the KOSPI index had over 50% of its trading days with a daily price change of over 5%. On July 31, the market experienced its largest single-day gain in history, with an 18% increase.

In response to the extreme market fluctuations, South Korean regulatory bodies have taken action. On July 31, the authorities raised the cash collateral requirement for individual stocks, resulting in a significant decline in trading volume and assets for funds linked to Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS).
Regulatory bodies have stated that they will continue to introduce measures to suppress market demand for high-leverage products.
Under the dual pressure of market losses and regulatory tightening, a large number of retail investors who had entered the market during the previous rally were forced out of the market.

According to data from the Korea Financial Investment Association, the total value of forced liquidations for retail investors in June was approximately 1 trillion KRW ($710 million), while in July, it reached 9.93 trillion KRW, the highest two months of the year.
As of August 4, the total outstanding balance of financing for stock trading had fallen to 27.4 trillion KRW, a new low for the year.

Viso, Chief Investment Officer at Dubai-based Arkevium Capital, believes that the Korean stock market is transitioning from a retail-dominated market to one led by institutional investors, but notes that "only a few days of stable performance are not enough, and overseas investors need to see clear evidence of the market's price discovery mechanism returning to normal operation".

After the sell-off, some valuation indicators for Korean stocks have fallen to relatively low levels, with the KOSPI index's 12-month forward P/E ratio falling to 5.1, a historic low. However, this low valuation has yet to attract significant capital inflows.

Looking back, Korean stocks experienced a strong rally earlier this year due to the AI chip craze, but the high volatility and market concentration on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix led to concerns of a bubble forming.

Daphne Lim, Manager at Singapore-based Dymon Asia Capital, notes that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are currently undervalued, with improving profit outlooks, but "the extremely high market volatility has made short-term investors more cautious, and capital will not flow back in large quantities quickly, but rather in small, incremental amounts".

Exchange data also shows that foreign investors have slowed their withdrawal from Korean stocks, but the sell pressure has not yet subsided. Following a record $3 billion monthly net outflow in June, foreign investors sold $620 million in July and $430 million in August.

Despite this, there are still optimistic voices in the market. Goldman Sachs has reaffirmed its 12-month target price for the KOSPI index at 12,000, representing a potential 90% upside from the previous Friday's closing price.

items.title: OpenAI神秘AI硬體曝！「甜甜圈」智慧音箱2027年登場、售價上看400美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Mysterious AI Hardware Leaked! "Donut-Shaped" Smart Speaker to Debut in 2027, Priced Above $400
paras: 據知情人士透露，OpenAI 備受期待的一款全新裝置將採用獨特外型設計，並加入可活動的零組件，藉此賦予裝置更鮮明的個性。不過，這款產品的售價可能超過 300 美元。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士表示，OpenAI 這款產品本質上是一款沒有螢幕的智慧音箱，外型將呈現類似甜甜圈的造型，尺寸約與曲棍球的球相當。
據悉，OpenAI 的設計理念是讓使用者能夠單手輕鬆拿著這款裝置在家中移動。
該公司希望透過這款產品開創全新的產品形態，預計於 2027 年推出。知情人士表示，這款裝置將定位為一款以 AI 為核心的電腦，能協助使用者完成各項工作。
此外，其外型設計也有望與目前市場上亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與 Google(GOOGL-US) 的智慧音箱有所區隔。
值得注意的是，這款全新硬體也將讓 OpenAI 有機會證明，其產品設計並非抄襲蘋果 (AAPL-US) 。目前兩家公司正陷入一場法律爭端，焦點在於 OpenAI 是否竊取蘋果的智慧財產權；OpenAI 則否認相關指控。
儘管 OpenAI 最終計畫推出一系列硬體裝置，但這款智慧音箱被視為公司進軍硬體市場的切入點。至於其他類型的全天候 AI 裝置，例如智慧眼鏡，則已引發外界對隱私問題的疑慮。
據悉，OpenAI 預期，使用者將在一天當中的不同時段頻繁使用這款智慧音箱。它的運作方式類似 ChatGPT 手機 App 中的語音模式，但將採用更先進的模型，提供更接近人與人之間的互動體驗。
知情人士表示，這款裝置還具備隨時間深入了解使用者的能力，能根據對使用者的認識調整對話方式，讓互動感覺更像是在與真人交流。
這款圓形裝置將搭載可自行移動的零組件。這些活動部件能在裝置回應或與使用者互動時提供視覺上的反應，讓產品看起來比現有固定式智慧音箱更加「有生命力」。
在硬體方面，產品將配備揚聲器孔與麥克風，用於接收使用者指令及進行語音對話。這款裝置採電池供電設計，可適應不同使用情境，例如拿在手中使用，或放置於床頭櫃、廚房檯面等位置。
OpenAI 還計畫在裝置上加入指示燈，讓使用者能清楚知道裝置何時正在聆聽，以增強互動體驗。
此外，裝置還將搭載相機系統及其他感測器，用於感知周遭環境，並將取得的視覺資訊提供給 AI。
從更長期的發展來看，OpenAI 的目標是建立完整的硬體設備業務，甚至希望有朝一日推出能夠取代現有智慧型手機的產品。
這款智慧音箱是與 Jony Ive 旗下設計公司 LoveFrom 合作開發。Ive 過去曾主導 iPhone、iPad、iPod 及 Apple Watch 等產品的外型與使用體驗設計，在蘋果建立了極高知名度。
延續 Ive 過去的設計風格，這款新裝置將採用高質感外觀，並使用高級金屬等高檔材質。知情人士透露，OpenAI 內部討論的售價約為每台 300 至 400 美元，價格將高於多數智慧音箱，但仍低於一支標準版 iPhone。
值得注意的是，金屬外觀設計也是蘋果對 OpenAI 提起訴訟時提出的指控之一。蘋果指稱，OpenAI 曾要求一家長期與蘋果合作的供應商，為其即將推出的產品開發一種金屬表面處理技術，而該技術與蘋果目前採用的技術相似。
蘋果在訴訟文件中指控：「OpenAI 及其合作夥伴誤導該供應商，使其相信 OpenAI 已獲得蘋果授權，能夠為 OpenAI 的利益使用這項機密金屬表面處理技術。」
OpenAI 則形容蘋果的相關指控「過於模糊且籠統」。目前也無法確定，蘋果訴訟所指的產品究竟就是這款甜甜圈造型裝置，還是 OpenAI 正在開發的另一款產品，甚至可能是已經取消的概念設計。
不過，這種環形外型設計，或是能夠隨手攜帶的智慧音箱概念，與蘋果目前的產品布局仍存在明顯差異。雖然蘋果目前已推出 HomePod 系列智慧音箱，但尚未推出電池供電版本，也還沒有正式推出以 AI 為核心的家用裝置。
知情人士透露，OpenAI 內部認為首款裝置並未使用或侵犯任何蘋果商業機密。蘋果提起訴訟後，OpenAI 也曾就相關問題展開內部調查。
OpenAI 在當地時間週三（12 日）晚間提交的駁回蘋果訴訟動議中，也特別強調這一點。文件寫道，「OpenAI 正在打造的產品，與蘋果任何產品都截然不同，是全新且不同的事物。」
然而，蘋果本週要求法院對 OpenAI 核發禁制令，若最終獲得法院批准，可能使 OpenAI 新產品的上市計畫更加複雜。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: According to sources, OpenAI's highly anticipated new device will feature a unique design with movable components, giving the device a more distinctive personality. However, the product's price may exceed $300.
According to a Bloomberg report, sources say OpenAI's product is essentially a screenless smart speaker with a design resembling a donut, measuring approximately the size of a hockey puck.
It is said that OpenAI's design concept is to allow users to easily move the device around their home with one hand.

The company hopes to create a new product form factor with this device, which is expected to be released in 2027. Sources say the device will be positioned as a core AI computer that can assist users with various tasks.
In addition, the design of this device may differentiate it from Amazon (AMZN-US) and Google (GOOGL-US) smart speakers currently on the market.

Notably, this new hardware will also give OpenAI the opportunity to prove that its product design is not a copy of Apple (AAPL-US). The two companies are currently embroiled in a legal dispute over whether OpenAI has stolen Apple's intellectual property; OpenAI has denied the allegations.

Although OpenAI plans to release a series of hardware devices, this smart speaker is seen as the company's entry point into the hardware market. Other types of all-day AI devices, such as smart glasses, have raised concerns about privacy issues.

Sources say OpenAI expects users to frequently use this smart speaker at different times of the day. Its operation is similar to the voice mode in the ChatGPT mobile app, but it will use more advanced models to provide a more human-like interaction experience.
This device also has the ability to understand users over time and adjust its dialogue style accordingly, making the interaction feel more like talking to a real person.

This round device will be equipped with movable components. These active parts can provide visual feedback when the device responds or interacts with the user, making the product look more "alive" than existing fixed smart speakers.

In terms of hardware, the product will be equipped with speaker holes and microphones for receiving user commands and voice conversations. This device uses a battery-powered design, which can adapt to different usage scenarios, such as being held in hand or placed on a bedside table or kitchen countertop.
OpenAI also plans to add indicator lights to the device, allowing users to clearly know when the device is listening, enhancing the interaction experience.
In addition, the device will be equipped with a camera system and other sensors to perceive the surrounding environment and provide visual information to AI.
Looking at the long-term development, OpenAI's goal is to establish a complete hardware business, even hoping to launch a product that can replace existing smart phones one day.

This smart speaker is developed in collaboration with LoveFrom, a design company founded by Jony Ive. Ive previously led the design and user experience of products such as iPhone, iPad, iPod, and Apple Watch, and has a high reputation at Apple.

Continuing Ive's design style, this new device will feature a high-quality appearance and use high-end materials such as high-end metals. Sources say that OpenAI's internal discussion of the price is around $300 to $400 per unit, which is higher than most smart speakers but lower than a standard iPhone.

Notably, the metal exterior design is also one of the allegations raised by Apple in its lawsuit against OpenAI. Apple claims that OpenAI asked a long-term supplier of Apple to develop a metal surface treatment technology for its upcoming product, which is similar to Apple's current technology.

Apple's lawsuit alleges that OpenAI and its partners misled the supplier, making them believe that OpenAI had obtained Apple's authorization to use the confidential metal surface treatment technology for OpenAI's benefit.

OpenAI describes Apple's allegations as "too vague and general". It is currently unclear whether the product referred to in Apple's lawsuit is this donut-shaped device or another product being developed by OpenAI, or even a canceled concept design.

However, this ring-shaped design or the concept of a portable smart speaker still differs significantly from Apple's current product lineup. Although Apple has released the HomePod series of smart speakers, it has not yet released a battery-powered version or a core AI-based home device.

Sources say that OpenAI believes that the first device does not use or infringe on any of Apple's commercial secrets. After Apple filed the lawsuit, OpenAI also conducted an internal investigation into the matter.

In the motion to dismiss Apple's lawsuit filed on Wednesday (12th) local time, OpenAI also emphasized this point. The document states, "The product OpenAI is creating is completely different from any Apple product and is a new and different thing."
However, Apple has requested the court to issue an injunction against OpenAI, which may make OpenAI's product launch plan more complicated if the court ultimately approves it.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美非農就業人口意外減少 美元周線連二黑
items.title_en: New York Foreign Exchange Market: US Non-Farm Employment Population Decreases, Dollar Falls for Second Consecutive Week
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周五 (7 日) 走軟，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，引發市場對美國經濟韌性的擔憂，也削弱了聯準會 (Fed) 升息的理由，進而拖累美元。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的 ICE 美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 0.44%，約報 99.50，本周共下跌 0.31%，連續第二周走軟。
美國勞工部公布，7 月非農就業人數減少 2.3 萬人，與路透調查經濟學家預期增加 8 萬人大相逕庭。美國失業率則降至 4.1%，但勞動參與率下滑至 61.4%，創近 5 年半低點。
就業報告公布後，美元兌日元貶值 0.57% 至 157.56 日元，但本周仍升值約 0.10%。由於美日當局上周聯合進行歷史性干預，美元兌日元一度跌至 13 周低點。
歐元兌美元上揚 0.39%，報 1.1568 美元，本周升值 0.41%。
美元走弱反映市場對 Fed 升息的預期降溫。根據芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具，市場目前預期 Fed 在 9 月維持利率不變的機率為 56%，高於前一日的 45%。
Macquarie Group 全球外匯及利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 說：「我認為，沒有人真的預期非農就業人數會出現負值，也沒有人預期 6 月就業數據會大幅下修。」
他進一步解釋：「我傾向認為，市場已將 Fed 升息時點從 9 月延後至 10 月或 12 月。每當數據顯示美國經濟疲弱，或勞動市場沒有原先認為的那麼強勁，市場就會把 Fed 升息的可能時點往後推。」
美國公債殖利率在就業報告公布後大幅下滑。通常追隨 Fed 利率預期走勢的 2 年期美債殖利率下跌 4.2 個基點，報 4.245%，基準的 10 年期美債殖利率下跌 2 個基點，報 4.649%。

paras_en: The US dollar softened against major currencies on Friday as the US non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased in July, sparking concerns about the resilience of the US economy and weakening the case for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, which in turn dragged down the dollar.

At the close of the New York market, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar's movement against six major currencies, fell 0.44% to around 99.50, marking a 0.31% decline for the week and its second consecutive weekly drop.

The US Labor Department reported that non-farm employment decreased by 23,000 in July, contrary to the expected increase of 80,000 predicted by Reuters' survey of economists. The US unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, but the labor participation rate slid to 61.4%, a near 5.5-year low.

Following the release of the employment report, the dollar depreciated 0.57% against the yen to 157.56 yen but still appreciated about 0.10% for the week. The dollar-yen exchange rate had hit a 13-week low after the US and Japanese authorities conducted a historic intervention the previous week.
The euro rose 0.39% against the dollar to $1.1568, marking a 0.41% gain for the week.

The dollar's weakness reflects a cooling of expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently sees a 56% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September, up from 45% the previous day.

Thierry Wizman, a global foreign exchange and interest rate strategist at Macquarie Group, said, 'I think nobody really expected the non-farm payroll to be negative, and nobody expected the June employment numbers to be revised downward significantly.'

He further explained, 'I tend to think the market has pushed back the timing of the Fed's rate hike from September to October or December. Whenever the data shows the US economy is weaker or the labor market is not as strong as previously thought, the market pushes back the potential timing of the rate hike.'

US Treasury yields plummeted after the employment report was released. The 2-year Treasury yield, which typically tracks Fed rate expectations, fell 4.2 basis points to 4.245%, while the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield dropped 2 basis points to 4.649%.

The dollar index was reported at 99.5996, down 0.03438%. The euro-to-dollar (EUR/USD) exchange rate was reported at 1 euro to 1.1557 US dollars, up 0.29%. items.title: 日元又突然急升！非農爆冷還是美日再度干預？
items.title_en: Yen Suddenly Surges Again! Is It Due to Cold Non-Farm Data or US-Japan Intervention?
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉為負成長，重挫聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期，帶動美元全面走弱，日元兌美元周五 (7 日) 盤中突然大漲。由於美日當局才在數日前聯手進場支撐日元，交易員也高度警戒官方可能再度干預匯市。
美元兌日元一度重挫 1.1% 至 156.68 日元，隨後跌幅略為收斂，最新報 157.16 日元，已明顯遠離 7 月觸及的 163.99 日元、40 年來高點。
目前尚不清楚日本當局是否再次進場干預。不過，分析師指出，美國就業數據遠遜預期，加上美債殖利率大幅下跌，已足以促使投資人拋售美元，因此這波日元升勢可能主要由基本面因素推動。
三菱日聯金融集團 (MUFG) 資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，非農就業數據低於預期的幅度非常大，觀察美國殖利率曲線短端的劇烈反應，美元下跌並不令人意外。由於非農就業出現負值相當罕見，這次數據對 Fed 升息預期造成明顯打擊，市場理應出現強烈反應，美元也可能面臨廣泛賣壓。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅則由原先公布的 5.7 萬人下修至 2 萬人。《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預估，7 月就業人口將增加 8 萬人，預測區間介於增加 1 萬至 14 萬人。
就業數據公布後不久，日本財務大臣表示，東京與華府一直保持「密切溝通」，必要時將毫不猶豫地干預匯市，進一步加深交易員戒心。
日本與美國上周五才罕見採取協調行動，共同買進日元，以阻止日元持續貶值。隨著疲弱非農數據為日元提供基本面支撐，加上美日官員持續釋出干預警告，市場正密切關注日元是否延續反彈，以及官方是否再次出手。
paras_en: The US 7-month non-farm employment data unexpectedly turned negative, severely undercutting the Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate hike expectations, leading to a sharp decline in the US dollar, and a sudden surge in the yen against the US dollar on Friday (7).

The US dollar against the yen plummeted by 1.1% to 156.68 yen, before narrowing its decline, and was last reported at 157.16 yen, clearly far removed from the 163.99 yen, a 40-year high touched in July.

It remains unclear whether Japanese authorities have intervened again in the foreign exchange market. However, analysts point out that the US employment data fell far short of expectations, coupled with a sharp decline in US Treasury yields, which is enough to prompt investors to sell the US dollar, and thus the yen's surge may be driven primarily by fundamental factors.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior foreign exchange analyst Lee Hardman stated that the non-farm employment data fell short of expectations by a very large margin, and observed a sharp reaction in the US short-term interest rate curve, making the decline in the US dollar not unexpected.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday that the non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased by 23,000 in July, and the June increase was revised downward to 20,000 from the originally reported 57,000. Reuters' survey of economists had previously estimated that the employment population would increase by 800,000 in July, with a prediction range of 100,000 to 1.4 million.

Shortly after the release of employment data, Japan's Finance Minister stated that Tokyo and Washington have maintained 'close communication', and would intervene in the foreign exchange market without hesitation if necessary, further deepening the caution among traders.

Japan and the US took a rare coordinated action last Friday, jointly buying the yen to block its continued depreciation. With weak non-farm data providing fundamental support for the yen, and US and Japanese officials continuing to issue warnings of intervention, the market is closely watching whether the yen will continue its rebound, and whether officials will intervene again.

items.title: 美日罕見聯手干預日元 高盛：彰顯美元儲備貨幣霸權不可替代
items.title_en: US and Japan Unite to Intervene in Yen, Goldman Sachs: Highlighting the Irreplaceable Dominance of Dollar as Reserve Currency
paras: 近期美國與日本展開罕見的聯合干預行動以支撐日元匯率，此舉引發外界對於美元作為儲備貨幣吸引力的討論。然而，高盛集團周四 (6 日) 發表報告指出，這次事件反而凸顯了美元在國際金融體系中無可取代的優勢，其深厚的市場深度與流動性，讓各國央行在市場劇烈波動時能迅速調用儲備。
日元先前因持續走弱而跌至 40 年來的低點，在美日協同干預前，日元兌美元匯率約為 164，干預後回升至約 158 左右。雖然部分市場人士擔心華盛頓對國債市場採取的積極態度可能令儲備管理者感到不安，但高盛認為這種擔憂是「過度跳躍的推論」。
高盛分析師表示，現任政府展現出比以往更強的干預意願，這並不代表美國國債市場出現新的脆弱性，反而體現了美元儲備在關鍵時刻的實用性。
高盛強調，美國資本市場的深度讓各國央行在平時能穩健累積美元，並在面臨壓力時順暢提取。此外，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 提議調高聯準會「外國及國際貨幣當局 (FIMA) 回購工具」的上限，這將允許各國央行透過抵押國債暫時換取美元，而非直接拋售國債，進而減少因突然拋售國債而產生的市場動盪。
儘管高盛也提到美元長期面臨美國制度不確定性等潛在風險，但日本的經驗再次證明，競爭對手難以企及美元的優勢。
報告結論指出：「當到了需要干預的時刻，絕大多數央行仍然需要美元。」
paras_en: The US and Japan have recently embarked on a rare joint intervention to support the yen, sparking discussions about the attractiveness of the dollar as a reserve currency. However, Goldman Sachs Group released a report on Thursday (6th) stating that this event has instead highlighted the dollar's irreplaceable dominance in the international financial system, with its deep market depth and liquidity allowing central banks to quickly draw on their reserves during market turmoil.

The yen had previously weakened to a 40-year low, with the exchange rate against the dollar around 164 before the joint intervention, and rebounded to around 158 after the intervention. Although some market participants are concerned that Washington's aggressive stance on the debt market may cause unease among reserve managers, Goldman Sachs believes this concern is an 'overly hasty inference'.

Goldman Sachs analysts point out that the current government has shown a stronger willingness to intervene, which does not represent a new vulnerability in the US debt market, but rather the practicality of dollar reserves in critical times.

Goldman Sachs emphasizes that the depth of the US capital market allows central banks to accumulate dollars stably in normal times and smoothly draw on them when facing pressure. Additionally, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent proposed increasing the ceiling for the Federal Reserve's 'Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repurchase Agreement Tool', which would allow central banks to temporarily exchange dollars for securities through collateral, rather than directly selling securities, thereby reducing market volatility caused by sudden sales of securities.

Although Goldman Sachs also mentions that the dollar faces potential risks such as US institutional uncertainty in the long term, Japan's experience once again proves that competitors cannot match the dollar's superiority.
The report concludes: 'When it's time to intervene, almost all central banks still need dollars.'

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯齊挫！一度摜破32.3關卡 中止連2升收32.288元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stock Index Suffer Losses as Tensions Rise
paras: 美伊緊張局勢再度升溫，台北股匯今 (7) 日同步走弱，新台幣兌美元匯率一度貶破 32.3 元關卡，不過，央行尾盤持續調節，終場貶幅收斂，收在 32.288 元、小貶 2.7 分，中止連二升，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 29.345 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 32.24 元，最高來到 32.2 元，但隨著美元買盤湧現，匯價由升轉貶，最低下探 32.35 元，不過，出口商伺機進場，加上央行也進場調節，帶動貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.288 元，小貶 2.7 分。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.20%，韓元強勢升值 0.66%，為本日最強亞幣，人民幣升值 0.07%，星幣微幅升值 0.02%，新台幣貶值 0.08%，日元重貶 0.34%，亞幣表現不同調。
台股今天一度上漲逾 430 點，但獲利了結賣壓出籠，指數翻黑下跌 170.79 點，終場收在 44225.91 點。外資賣超台股 407 億元。
受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒影響，美元周四表現支撐，投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場把焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: The Taiwan dollar and stock index suffered losses today as tensions between the US and Iran escalated, causing the dollar to rise against the Taiwan dollar. The Taiwan dollar fell to a low of 32.3 against the US dollar, but the central bank intervened to stabilize the market, resulting in a smaller loss of 2.7 points to close at 32.288.

The Taiwan dollar opened at 32.24 against the US dollar and rose to a high of 32.2, but then turned lower as dollar buying pressure increased. The lowest point was 32.35, but exporters and the central bank intervened to stabilize the market, resulting in a smaller loss of 2.7 points to close at 32.288.

The major currencies against the US dollar showed varying performances today, with the dollar index rising 0.20%, the Korean won rising 0.66% to become the strongest Asian currency, the Chinese yuan rising 0.07%, the Hong Kong dollar rising 0.02%, the Taiwan dollar falling 0.08%, the Japanese yen falling 0.34%, and the Asian currencies showing mixed performances.

The Taiwan stock index rose over 430 points at one point today, but then sold off due to profit-taking, resulting in a loss of 170.79 points to close at 44225.91. Foreign investors sold 407 billion Taiwan dollars worth of stocks.

The dollar rose today due to market concerns about monetary policy, with investors selling US bonds and pushing up the yield on US Treasury bonds. The market is now focusing on the release of the July non-farm employment report on Friday, which will be an important indicator of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions.

items.title: 日元已回吐近半干預漲幅 美日匯率保衛戰恐還有第二輪要打
items.title_en: Yen Gives Back Nearly Half of Intervention Gain, Fears of Second Round of Intervention Rise
paras: 日元兌美元匯率在經歷美日聯合干預後的強勁反彈後，近期已回吐近半漲幅，引發市場對於當局是否會發動「第二輪保衛戰」的熱烈討論。
截至周五下午，日元兌美元匯率跌至 158.40 附近，遠低於周一創下的 155.23 強勢高點。就在上周，日元兌美元一度逼近 164 的四十年低點，隨後引發日本與美國自 1998 年以來的首次聯合買入日元行動。
此次匯率回調凸顯了單純干預手段，在扭轉日元長期貶值趨勢上的局限性。美日之間顯著的利差、日本沉重的債務負擔，以及地緣政治不確定性均持續向日元施壓。隨著中東局勢導致油價上漲，市場對緊張局勢緩和的樂觀情緒減弱，支撐美元周四錄得兩周來最大單日漲幅。
市場分析指出，隨著匯率再度逼近 160 的關鍵整數關口，當局再次出手干預的可能性極高。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師 Carol Kong 警告，若日元跌破 160 關口而當局未採取行動，將鼓勵交易員重新建立日元空頭部位，這正是政策制定者極力想避免的結果。事實上，日本在春季黃金周期間已曾三次干預匯市，顯示出其最大化心理衝擊的決心。
然而，干預的長效性仍取決於貨幣政策的配合。華僑銀行策略師 Moh Siong Sim 認為，干預若要發揮實質效果，必須配合日本央行更激進的升息，或是聯準會轉向寬鬆政策。目前，隔夜指數掉期顯示日本央行在 9 月前升息的機率約為 60%。
日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，當局將協調匯率走勢與貨幣政策共同應對。
展望未來，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 的「不惜一切代價」言論，暗示干預行動並非一次性事件。投資者目前正密切關注即將公布的美國非農就業報告與通膨數據，這些數據將成為決定日元是否會面臨新一輪拋售壓力的關鍵催化劑。
paras_en: The yen has given back nearly half of its gain since the joint intervention by Japan and the US, sparking heated discussions about whether the authorities will launch a second round of intervention.

As of Friday afternoon, the yen traded at around 158.40, far below the strong high of 155.23 set on Monday. Just last week, the yen briefly approached a 40-year low of 164, prompting Japan and the US to take their first joint action to buy yen since 1998.

The recent reversal of the yen's rate highlights the limitations of relying solely on intervention to reverse the yen's long-term depreciation trend. The significant interest rate differential between the US and Japan, Japan's heavy debt burden, and geopolitical uncertainty all continue to put pressure on the yen. With the Middle East situation driving up oil prices, market optimism about easing tensions has weakened, supporting the dollar's two-week high on Thursday.
Market analysts point out that with the yen rate again approaching the key integer threshold of 160, the possibility of the authorities intervening again is extremely high.

Australian Federal Bank strategist Carol Kong warns that if the yen breaks below the 160 threshold without intervention, it will encourage traders to rebuild yen short positions, which is exactly what policymakers are trying to avoid. In fact, Japan has intervened in the currency market three times during the spring golden period, showing its determination to maximize psychological impact.

However, the long-term effectiveness of intervention still depends on the coordination of monetary policy. OCBC Bank strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that intervention will only have a real impact if it is accompanied by the Bank of Japan's more aggressive interest rate hikes or the Fed's shift to a more accommodative policy. Currently, the overnight index swap shows that the Bank of Japan has a 60% chance of raising interest rates before September.
Japan's top foreign exchange official, Mitsuru Miyazawa, said that the authorities will coordinate the exchange rate trend with monetary policy to respond together.

Looking ahead, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's 'no matter what' comments suggest that intervention is not a one-time event. Investors are closely watching the upcoming US non-farm payroll and inflation data, which will be key catalysts for determining whether the yen will face a new round of selling pressure.

items.title: 先斬後奏！ FT：美賣歐元推高日元   歐洲央行直到交易執行才收到華府通知
items.title_en: FT: US Sells Euro to Boost Yen, ECB Only Notified After Fact
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國上週五 (7 月 31 日) 為提振日元而賣出歐元的操作，令歐洲央行 (ECB) 措手不及，因華府在這筆歷史性匯市干預執行完畢後，才通知法蘭克福方面。
《金融時報》今 (7) 日引述多位消息人士報導，ECB 是在上週五交易成交後，才得知美國出售歐元、買入日元的動向，ECB 總裁拉加德與美國財長貝森特也在隔天就此次干預通話。
報導指出，這種「先斬後奏」凸顯出近 30 年來美日首度聯手護匯的不尋常。按戰後西方貨幣當局慣例，美國若介入匯市通常動用美元，而非動用歐元。
部分 ECB 高層認為，華府改用歐元交易，是對西方央行長期合作慣例的「空前違背」。
一名了解歐洲決策層討論的人士形容，紐約聯準銀行代表美國財政部執行的賣歐元行動「非常引人注目」且「令人遺憾」，並稱「這種事從未發生過」，二戰後西方靠互信與事前磋商維繫的匯市協調傳統，可能正受威脅。
美國財政部發言人表示，透過「匯率穩定基金」(ESF) 配置儲備資產的決定由華府自作主張，不與外國當局協調。「ESF 資產配置由財政部依市場流動性、估值等評估定奪」，上週透過 ESF 在內部重配準備資產屬職權範圍。
一名白宮官員更說：「我們尊重與國際同僚私下討論的機密性，不像 ECB。」
華府選擇賣歐元而非賣美元，主因是怕拋美元被解讀為弱勢美元信號、打臉貝森特「強勢美元政策」。
分析師也揣測，美國陪日本出手，是想避免後者在美債殖利率逼近 19 年高點時賣債換美元。
日本在 7 月最後兩天估計耗資約 13.8 兆日元 (870 億美元)，已超過 4-5 月創下的 11.73 兆日元舊紀錄。
美日上週五聯手把美元兌日元從近 164(1986 年以來低點) 拉回 157，其後略貶至 158。
市場仍憂心日本央行 (BOJ) 升息太慢，BOJ 總裁植田和男上月會議按兵不動，但坦言「通膨上行風險需更關注」，市場看好下月升息機率約 44%。
美國這次「用歐元救日元」的非常規操作，短期震懾套利空頭，卻也讓西方貨幣協調的信任底線露出一道裂痕。
paras_en: A US operation to boost the yen by selling euros last Friday (July 31) caught the European Central Bank (ECB) off guard, as Washington only notified Frankfurt after the historic intervention.

The Financial Times reported on July 7 that the ECB only learned of the US sale of euros and purchase of yen after the trade was completed on Friday, with ECB President Christine Lagarde and US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin speaking about the intervention the following day.
The 'shoot first, tell later' approach highlights the unusual nature of the US-Japan alliance to defend their currencies, which has not happened in nearly 30 years.
Some ECB officials view the US decision to use euros in the intervention as a 'historic breach' of the long-standing cooperation between Western central banks.

A person familiar with the European decision-making process described the New York Federal Reserve's sale of euros as 'highly unusual' and 'regrettable', saying 'this has never happened before', and that the post-war tradition of Western currency coordination based on trust and prior consultation may be under threat.

A US Treasury spokesperson said that the decision to use the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to allocate reserve assets was made by Washington without coordination with foreign authorities, stating that 'ESF asset allocation is determined by the Treasury Department based on market liquidity, valuation, and other assessments'.
A White House official added that 'we respect the confidentiality of private discussions with international colleagues, unlike the ECB'.
The US chose to sell euros instead of dollars to avoid being seen as a sign of a weak dollar, which would undermine Mnuchin's 'strong dollar policy'.
Analysts speculate that the US joined Japan to avoid the latter selling bonds and buying dollars when US bond yields approached a 19-year high.
Japan is estimated to have spent around ¥13.8 trillion (approximately $870 billion) in the last two days of July, exceeding the previous record of ¥11.73 trillion set in April-May.
The US and Japan jointly pushed the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 164 (a 1986 low) back to 157 on Friday, and it later fell to 158.

Markets remain concerned that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may be raising interest rates too slowly, with BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda saying in a recent meeting that 'the risk of inflation rising is more pressing', and market expectations for a rate hike in August are around 44%.
The US's unconventional use of euros to rescue the yen has temporarily shaken out short sellers, but has also exposed a crack in the trust between Western currency coordinators.

items.title: 今年干預次數額度疑似用完！日本黃金週期間三度出手護日元 Q2砸11.74兆創單季新高
items.title_en: Intervention Quota Seems Exhausted! Japan Acts Three Times During Golden Week to Support Yen, Q2 Intervention Hits 11.74 Trillion Yen, a New Quarterly Record
paras: 日本財務省今 (7) 日公佈今年第二季每日干預明細，證實在 4 月 30 日、5 月 4 日、5 月 6 日三度買入日元，金額分別為 6.28 兆、0.78 兆、4.68 兆日元，合計 11.74 兆日元(約 785 億美元)，創日本歷次匯市防衛單季最高規模。
根據日本財務省數據，今年第二季較上月底美日聯手多出一輪單邊操作，且確認除上述三天外，黃金週期間曾有五次盤中急貶，當局未做其他平滑干預。出手干預前，日元兌美元匯率跌破 160，三輪出手後匯價拉回 155 附近。
日本財務省數據加上週五 (7 月 31 日) 與華府協同買進日元，市場推算日本在 IMF 規則下的 2026 會計年度干預額度已觸頂，與華府聯手觸發「六個月冷卻期」重置機制。理論上，日本直到 2027 年初前，不能再次單邊進場。
對日元套利交易者，干預額度疑似用罄是明確綠燈，空頭不必再防「隨時有 8 兆級砸盤」，倉位回補意願上升。
但部分投資人存疑，川普時代「基於規則的干預框架」實際約束力弱化，若日元再破 165，華府是否默許東京破例或改以口頭 + 美債端配合，仍留灰色地帶。
短期看，匯市波動率料將回落，但 2027 前「無干預承諾」本身，也可能成為下一輪空頭加槓桿的催化。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance today (the 7th) released the daily intervention details for the second quarter of this year, confirming three yen purchases on April 30, May 4, and May 6, amounting to 6.28 trillion, 0.78 trillion, and 4.68 trillion yen respectively, for a total of 11.74 trillion yen (about $78.5 billion), the largest single‑quarter foreign‑exchange market defence operation in Japan's history.

According to Ministry data, the second quarter saw one more unilateral operation compared with the end of last month’s US‑Japan joint effort, and besides the three days above, there were five intraday sharp depreciations during Golden Week that the authorities did not smooth with additional intervention. Before the interventions, the yen‑dollar rate had fallen below 160, and after the three rounds it rebounded to around 155.

Combined with the coordinated yen purchase with Washington on Friday (July 31), market participants estimate that Japan’s intervention quota for the 2026 fiscal year under IMF rules has been reached, triggering a “six‑month cooling‑off” reset mechanism with the U.S. In theory, Japan cannot make another unilateral entry until early 2027.

For yen arbitrage traders, the apparent depletion of the intervention quota is a clear green light; short sellers no longer need to guard against a sudden 8‑trillion‑yen dump, and their willingness to cover positions is increasing.

However, some investors remain skeptical, noting that the rule‑based intervention framework from the Trump era had weakened in enforceability; if the yen were to slip past 165, it is unclear whether Washington would tacitly allow Tokyo an exception or resort to verbal coordination plus U.S. Treasury actions, leaving a gray area.
In the short term, FX volatility is expected to ease, but the lack of an “intervention commitment” through 2027 could itself become a catalyst for the next wave of short‑selling leverage.

隨著日本財務數據顯示，得益於美國與日本聯合干預後日圓走強及海外債券收益率維持高位提振需求，日本投資人三周來首度淨買入海外債券，限制日圓上漲，並據人力資源機構 Challenger Gray & Christmas 報告，美國 7 月雇主計畫裁員數降至 2024 年 7 月以來最低 33,429 人，而且美國勞工部公布上周初請失業金人數為 19.9 萬人低於預期及第二季勞動生產率以年化 1.4% 的速度增長遠高於預估值，激勵美元兌日圓漲至 158.55 高點。今日市場聚焦美國就業報告，預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於 158.00-20，阻力於 159.00-20。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲數據顯示，黃金和鐵礦石出口強勁反彈，且進口經歷強勁增長後趨平穩，6 月商品貿易收支意外轉為 19 億澳幣順差，並隨著市場基本排除澳洲央行 (RBA) 下周會議加息的可能性，但料措辭偏鷹，亦堅信紐西蘭央行 (RBNZ) 在 9 月會議升息，而且荷姆茲海峽航運達成協議的希望支撐澳幣和紐元等風險貨幣，帶動歐元兌美元觸及 1.1559 高點。
隨後德國公布經季節性及日曆調整後 6 月工業訂單較前月大增 3.1%，經季節調整製造業產出價格亦升 9.9%，但歐元區 6 月零售銷售較前月跌 0.3% 及較去年同期增長 0.7% 皆遜於預期，而且伊朗議會審議禁止美國和以色列船隻進入荷姆茲海峽法案草案，打擊歐元兌美元至 1.1514 低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於 1.1520-40，支撐於 1.1440-60。
◆GBP/USD

週四標準普爾 (S&P) 全球調查英國 7 月建築業採購經理人指數 (PMI) 升至 44.7 及商業建築活動指數創四個月新高 46.8，建築商信心升至伊朗戰爭前以來最高，而且全球金融市場對伊朗和阿曼達成協議的期望升溫，提振英鎊兌美元至 1.3479 高點。隨著市場對英國央行 (BOE) 升息的預期恐過於激進，而且美國就業數據前的避險操作支撐美元，打壓英鎊兌美元至 1.3445 低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於 1.3450-70，支撐於 1.3360-80。

Today's market focus is on the US employment report, with support at 158.00-20 and resistance at 159.00-20.
